question: How great a material wealth is declared insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined.
Such immense wealth could be accumulated.
This is posed as a measure of comparison.
inference: Even wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels is not an adequate equivalent.
uncertainties: The fused form ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is read as ratnasaṃpūrṇam+akretuṃ/kartuṃ in sense.
plain_english: Even if one had enough wealth to fill the ocean with jewels...
